description: Annual work and financial report of a fictional residential community management committee in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan usage: ROC years, NT$), printed by Chromium in WenQuanYi Zen Hei with justified paragraphs, first-line indents, tables and a footer "第 N 頁／共 M 頁". Seven edits: an inspection frequency word in section 參一 (每年 to 每半年); the paragraph on recycling moved from 參一 (facilities) to 參三 (cleaning), crossing a page; a sentence deleted at the end of a paragraph in 參四; the closing balance of the public fund corrected (two digits transposed, 1,284,600 to 1,248,600; the other rows of that table are unchanged); the proposed management fee in the first item of the 115 work plan list; a new last item (6.) added to that list, so no other item is renumbered; and one meeting date in the appendix table on the last page. Re-flow and footer page numbers change only as consequences. Producer: Chromium (Skia/PDF m153, Playwright page.pdf), HTML/CSS, WenQuanYi Zen Hei.

truth.note: Fire safety inspection frequency in section 參一; Chinese is compared character by character, so the change is the insertion of 半 (每年 to 每半年).
